items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: We did some great stuff in those days with a band called Joe Swanson, he was the leader.

ctx.x: Gee. I wonder if that music is still around? Do you think it still exists?

I don’t know. We did some great stuff in those days with a band called Joe Swanson, he was the leader. Joe Swanson couldn’t play very well though. There was a lady there with © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
quite a bit of money that wanted him to have a band. And he had a guy named Paul Villipeig, do you know that name?
